canonical_stones.title: Planetary Street Orbits & Star-Regulated Civic Rites
canonical_stones.calvino_stone: Every street follows a planet's orbit, and the buildings and places of community life repeat the order of the constellations and the position of the most luminous stars (Antares, Alpheratz, Capella, the Cepheids); markets, trades, ceremonies, and harvests follow the revolutions of the celestial vault rather than seasons.

canonical_stones.title: Prudent Earthly Innovations & Bidirectional Sky Coupling
canonical_stones.calvino_stone: Though visitors praise Andria's immobility, astronomers looking through telescopes after cautious municipal innovations point out 1:1 corresponding novelties in heaven.

canonical_couplings.earthly_innovation: Suspended street built over a bamboo grove
canonical_couplings.celestial_novelty: Nova explosion ignited in a star cluster

canonical_couplings.earthly_innovation: Shadow-theater opened in place of the municipal kennels
canonical_couplings.celestial_novelty: Gaseous nebula condensing into a nascent planet

canonical_couplings.earthly_innovation: Statue of Thales raised at the port
canonical_couplings.celestial_novelty: Orbital perturbation in Saturn's rings and outer star

canonical_couplings.earthly_innovation: Toboggan slide added to the school of gymnastics
canonical_couplings.celestial_novelty: Curved expansion of the Milky Way

canonical_stones.title: Self-Confidence & Prudence Cosmic Calculation
canonical_stones.calvino_stone: Citizens weigh every earthly change with self-confidence and prudence before taking any decision, calculating risks and advantages for themselves, the city, and all worlds.
